attributes.name: Staff of Life
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card and choose a character at your location to recharge a random card from his discard pile.

For your exploration, reveal this card and discard a spell to choose another character at your location to shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from her discard pile into her deck.

Reveal this card and bury a spell that has the Healing trait to choose a dead character. His player shuffles 10 of his buried cards at random into his deck and draws a new hand. The character is no longer dead.
